questions.text: This is a plain 60 × 30 × 46 mm box with vertical walls, a flat 1800 mm² top, a 4.76 mm section, and no overhangs or bridges. Its shape doesn't say what it's for. What is it for?

options.label: Functional / structural (housing, bracket, load-bearing)
options.impact: A third wall loop closes the 4.76 mm section to 1.2 mm of shell, and 25% gyroid gives near-isotropic strength through the 30 mm width where bending stress concentrates; slightly longer print.

options.label: Container or enclosure (sealed top, holds contents)
options.impact: Six top layers (1.2 mm solid) seal the 1800 mm² flat top against leaks or debris; walls and infill stay at preset because the 4.76 mm section already carries the rim in shear.

options.label: Decorative or display (surface finish shows)
options.impact: A third wall loop smooths the 60 × 46 mm faces where layer lines are most visible; lighter infill saves material since the 4.76 mm section isn't loaded.

options.label: General purpose (just needs to print well)
options.impact: Every preset value holds: 2 wall loops on the 4.76 mm section with 15% zig-zag give adequate strength for a simple box; 5 top layers close the 1800 mm² flat top at 1.0 mm; no feature demands a deviation.
options.why: The part has no overhang, no bridge, no slenderness risk, and a 4.76 mm section that's already thick relative to 2 wall loops; with no stated load or finish demand, the Sponsor's tuned preset is the right call.
